invalid_reason: Kaggle run 360757510 used Internet on, violating the frozen Internet-off requirement. Its negative metrics are retained but are not accepted scientific evidence.
question: Can an uncertainty-aware recurrent residual model improve horizon-8 synthetic dynamics prediction under clean, corrupted-observation, and shifted-dynamics regimes?
falsifiers: Worst-regime horizon-8 MSE is not at least 10 percent below the best learned control.
The paired dataset-cluster bootstrap interval is not entirely below zero.
Clean horizon-8 MSE regresses by more than 0.02 versus the residual control.
Empirical 90 percent coverage differs from nominal by more than 0.10.
Any source mismatch, seed overlap, non-finite value, missing denominator, resource refusal, timeout, or post-freeze change occurs.
protected_boundary: Protected data is generated only after source/protocol freeze and after all learned checkpoints are written.
predecessor_policy: All completed studies and outcomes are unchanged; no prior protected evidence is reused.
claim_boundary: Fresh bounded synthetic dynamics only; no family identity, target-scale capability, SOTA, deployment, safety, or promotion claim.
